answer: A claim faces a blind jury. A raven draws five strangers from the grove, and a zephyr courier carries the sealed record. Each juror redoes one step live within an hour and votes blind, staking five cents; a vote against the verdict loses its stake. Fewer than four votes is a failed verdict: claim dead, claimant barred a week. An honest worker risks five cents on one job; a farmer with 1,000 fakes must buy four votes in 1,000 juries and burns $50.
